key.name: modifier-prefix
key.description: Modifier key combination prepended to each vowel key. Changing this updates all five vowel shortcuts at once. Examples: <Super><Alt>, <Ctrl><Alt>, <Super><Shift>

key.name: show-notification
key.description: Show a notification when an accented character is copied to the clipboard
